description: Compares Endform run counts, pass rates, and durations over time. Use this first to identify patterns, then use query_samples to inspect concrete matching executions and errors.

dataset.description: Whether to aggregate suite-level or individual test-run records.

endingAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp at which the period ends. Defaults to request time.

groupBy.description: Optional grouping dimension. Suite runs cannot be grouped by test or project.

metric.description: Aggregate to calculate: count, pass-rate, or average-duration.

organizationId.description: Optional organization to query. Omit this when the login has access to one organization.

period.description: Positive integer followed by H, D, W, or M. Defaults to 7D.

where.description:
Optional analytics filter expression.
Filter expression: comma-separated `key operator value` clauses, for example `suite.repository = endformdev/endform, suite.directory = e2e`. Quote values containing spaces, commas, or pipes. `in` and `!in` values use `|` separators.

Suite-run keys:
  branch, commitSha, suite.id, suite.repository, suite.directory,
  suiteRun.id, suiteRun.outcome, suiteRun.durationSeconds,
  suiteRun.maxTestAttemptsCount

Test-run keys include every suite-run key plus:
  test.id, test.name, test.location, test.describes,
  testRun.id, testRun.outcome, testRun.projectName,
  testRun.testAttemptsCount, testRun.durationSeconds,
  testAttempt.id, testAttempt.outcome, testAttempt.errorMessage,
  testAttempt.errorLocation, testAttempt.durationSeconds

String operators: = != ^= $= ~= !~=; selected fields also support in !in.
Number operators: = != > >= < <=; selected fields also support in !in.
Outcomes are pass or fail. Duration values are seconds.

For test-runs, a testAttempt.* clause matches a run when any attempt satisfies it. Responses contain every attempt in testAttempts, ordered earliest to latest. Filter keys map directly to response paths except singular testAttempt.* maps to each item in testAttempts.

name: query_analytics
